overview.name: Open MC Server Infrastructure (OMCSI)
overview.description: A comprehensive, production-ready Minecraft server infrastructure built with Docker containers and Spring Boot microservices. It provides automated server management, monitoring, backups, alerts, and AI-driven administration through a Discord bot.
overview.tech_stack: Java 21, Spring Boot 3.2.0, Docker, Gradle, Nginx, JDA (Java Discord API), Anthropic Claude API

minecraft-wrapper.description: Core service that wraps and manages the Minecraft server process. Provides REST API endpoints for starting, stopping, restarting the server, checking status, viewing metrics, and retrieving logs. Handles graceful shutdown with player countdown warnings.
key_endpoints: POST /api/server/stop - Gracefully stop with player warnings
GET /api/server/status - Get server running state, PID, uptime
GET /api/server/metrics - Get JVM heap, TPS, memory, uptime
GET /api/server/logs?lines=N - Get recent server log lines
POST /api/plugins/deploy - Deploy a plugin JAR file
configuration: MINECRAFT_WRAPPER_URL - Base URL for the wrapper service (default: http://minecraft-wrapper:8092)

web-app.description: Web dashboard for monitoring and administering the Minecraft server. Provides a browser-based UI with server status display, RCON console for executing commands, player activity tracking with leaderboards, and plugin management. Supports HTTPS via Nginx reverse proxy.
features: Player activity tracker with stats and leaderboard
configuration: WEBAPP_URL - Base URL for the web app (default: http://webapp:8080)

backup-manager.description: Automated backup management service. Performs scheduled backups of the Minecraft server world data using configurable cron expressions. Supports manual backup triggers, backup size management, and provides status information about recent backups.
configuration: BACKUP_MANAGER_URL - Base URL for the backup manager (default: http://backup-manager:8091)
BACKUP_CRON - Cron expression for scheduled backups
BACKUP_MAX_COUNT - Maximum number of backups to retain

alert-manager.description: Centralized alert notification service. Receives alerts from other services and forwards them to configured channels including Discord webhooks and Minecraft server RCON. Supports multiple alert levels and maintains an alert history.
key_endpoints: GET /api/alerts?limit=N - Get recent alerts with limit
configuration: ALERT_MANAGER_URL - Base URL for the alert manager (default: http://alert-manager:8090/api/alerts)
DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL - Discord webhook URL for alert notifications
ALERT_DISCORD_ENABLED - Enable/disable Discord alert notifications
ALERT_RCON_ENABLED - Enable/disable Minecraft RCON alert notifications

agent-manager.description: Discord-based AI agent for natural language server management. Uses Anthropic Claude API to interpret user commands and execute server management actions. Features a confirmation flow for destructive operations, per-tool confirmation toggles, and integration with all other OMCSI services.
configuration: AGENT_ENABLED - Enable/disable the agent (default: false)
AGENT_DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN - Discord bot token for authentication
AGENT_DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID - Discord channel ID to listen on
AGENT_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY - Anthropic API key for Claude
AGENT_START_SERVER_REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION - Require confirmation for start (default: true)
AGENT_STOP_SERVER_REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION - Require confirmation for stop (default: true)
AGENT_RESTART_SERVER_REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION - Require confirmation for restart (default: true)
AGENT_TRIGGER_BACKUP_REQUIRES_CONFIRMATION - Require confirmation for backup (default: true)
DIAGNOSTICS_LOGS_ENABLED - Include server logs in diagnostics (default: false)
DIAGNOSTICS_LOGS_ANONYMIZE - Redact IP addresses in logs (default: true)
DIAGNOSTICS_WEBAPP_ENABLED - Include webapp data in diagnostics (default: false)

nginx.description: Reverse proxy and HTTPS termination. Routes external traffic to internal services and handles SSL certificate management. Provides secure access to the web dashboard.
configuration: SSL certificates should be placed in nginx/ssl/ (not committed to git)
Use scripts/generate-ssl-certs.sh to generate self-signed certificates

quick_start: 2. Copy sample.env to .env and configure your settings: cp sample.env .env
3. Start all services: ./up.sh (runs docker compose up -d --build)
4. Access the web dashboard at http://localhost:8080 (or https://localhost:8443)
5. Stop all services: ./down.sh (runs docker compose down)
prerequisites: For the AI agent: Discord bot token, Discord channel ID, and Anthropic API key
For HTTPS: SSL certificates (generate with scripts/generate-ssl-certs.sh)

architecture.description: OMCSI uses a microservices architecture with Docker containers orchestrated via Docker Compose. All backend services are Spring Boot applications communicating via REST APIs. The Nginx reverse proxy handles external traffic routing and HTTPS termination.
architecture.docker_compose: compose.yml defines 6 services and 3 Docker volumes. All services are connected through a Docker network for internal communication.
architecture.data_flow: Users interact via the Web Dashboard or Discord bot. The agent-manager interprets natural language commands using Claude AI and calls the appropriate service APIs. The minecraft-wrapper directly manages the Minecraft server process. The backup-manager performs scheduled and on-demand backups. The alert-manager distributes notifications to Discord and the Minecraft server.
volumes: minecraft-data - Persistent Minecraft server world data

scripts.up.sh: Start all services with docker compose up -d --build
scripts.down.sh: Stop all services with docker compose down
scripts.upgrade.sh: Upgrade the infrastructure to the latest version
scripts.trigger-backup.sh: Trigger a manual backup via the backup-manager REST API
scripts.scripts/ci-local.sh: Run local CI validation (shell syntax, ShellCheck, Docker config validation)
scripts.scripts/generate-ssl-certs.sh: Generate self-signed SSL certificates for HTTPS
scripts.scripts/test-docker-graceful-shutdown.sh: Test graceful shutdown in Docker environment

configuration.description: Configuration is managed through environment variables defined in a .env file. The sample.env file provides a template with all available options and their defaults.
key_settings: Minecraft server settings (version, memory, game mode, etc.)
Discord integration (bot token, channel ID, webhook URL)
Anthropic API key for the AI agent

self_hosting.description: OMCSI can be self-hosted on any machine with Docker support. The SELF-HOSTING.md guide covers network configuration, firewall rules, port forwarding, security hardening, and troubleshooting for home server deployments.

ci_cd.description: GitHub Actions workflows handle continuous integration and deployment. The ci.yml workflow validates code on push and pull requests. The test-server-run.yml workflow performs end-to-end server build and startup testing.
workflows: ci.yml - Code validation, security scanning, and build verification
test-server-run.yml - End-to-end server build and startup test (includes Spigot compilation, 15-25 min)
